subscriptionInfo: Subscriptions are billed yearly and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

upgrade.title: Upgrade your membership?
upgrade.description: Your current plan will be upgraded to {{planName}} once you confirm.

disabled.title: Downgrade not allowed
disabled.description: You can't switch to a lower-tier plan while your current membership is active.

locked.title: Use your remaining sessions first
locked.description: You still have {{count}} sessions left on your current plan. Use them before upgrading.

hidden.title: You already have an active membership
hidden.description: You're currently subscribed through the web. Manage your membership from there.

purchase.processingBody: Please wait while we confirm your purchase with Apple…
purchase.successBody: Your membership is active. Enjoy tracking your athletes!
purchase.errorBody: We could not verify your purchase. Please try again or contact support.
purchase.unconfirmedBody: Apple has received your payment, but we could not confirm it yet. Do not buy again: we keep retrying automatically and your purchase will be added to your account. If it does not appear within a day, contact info@liviolive.com.
purchase.otherAccountBody: This subscription belongs to another Livio account. Log in with that account, or contact info@liviolive.com.
purchase.creditedOtherBody: This purchase was made from another Livio account and has been added to that account.

restorePending.title: Purchase being activated
restorePending.message: We found your purchase. It is being activated and will show up in your profile within a few minutes.

restoreOtherAccount.title: Linked to another account
restoreOtherAccount.message: This subscription belongs to another Livio account. Log in with that account, or contact info@liviolive.com.

unconfirmed.title: Payment still being confirmed
unconfirmed.message: Apple has received a payment from you that we are still confirming. Please wait until it is added to your account before buying another one.
unconfirmed.banner: We are still confirming a payment Apple received from you. You don't need to buy again.
unconfirmed.retryDoneMessage: Your payment has been confirmed and added to your account.
unconfirmed.retryStillMessage: We could not confirm your payment yet. We keep trying automatically - you don't need to buy again.

paymentPending.title: Purchase being activated
paymentPending.message: Your previous purchase is still being activated. Please wait a few minutes before buying again.

pendingApproval.title: Waiting for approval
pendingApproval.message: Your purchase is waiting for approval (for example Ask to Buy). You have not been charged yet. It will be added once it is approved.

restoreCreditedOther.title: Added to another account
restoreCreditedOther.message: This purchase was made from another Livio account and has been added to that account.
